name: Gradaly v4.4.0
title: Gradaly v4.4.0
notes:
### 🐍 Python Code Execution, Live AI Query Inspector & Custom PDF Filenames
- **Native Python Code Execution Sandbox (`code_execution` / `code_interpreter`) & Compatibility Test**: Optional advanced setting (disabled by default) enabling native server-side Python code execution during rubric design and copy evaluation on Google Gemini (`code_execution`), OpenAI (`/v1/responses` `code_interpreter`), and Anthropic (`/v1/messages` `code_execution_20250825`), with a 1-click model compatibility test.
- **Live AI Query & Image Inspector (`👁️ AI Query`) & Statement Source Selector (`Student Copy` vs. `Canvas`)**: Per-question `AI Statement: [Student Copy] / [Canvas]` option (essential when student copies contain individualized numerical parameters) and an interactive `👁️ AI Query` modal in the Grading and Review tabs to inspect the exact cropped/stitched image, its source breakdown, System & User prompts, and the full HTTP JSON payload.
- **Enhanced `.debug/grading/inspect.html` Diagnostic Reports**: Standalone visual `inspect.html` report alongside `image_source.json`, `request_payload.json`, `prompt.txt`, `image.jpg`, and `raw_api_response.json` (including executed Python code and stdout).
- **Single-Question Evaluation Interrupt (`✕ Stop`) & Flexible Annotated PDF Filenames**: Instant interrupt button for single-question evaluation, customizable filename patterns (`{nom}`, `{prenom}`, `{id}`, `{projet}`, `{copie}`, `{groupe}`) for annotated PDF exports, full pagination for Vision model discovery, and bounded timeouts for local Apple Vision OCR matching.
